pages.text: Supported workstations include crafting and cartography tables, stonecutters, anvils, smithing tables, looms, grindstones and enchanting tables.$(br2)Cargo enchanting tables provide base-level enchanting. Anvils use experience and wear normally. Unadapted workstations can still be transported as ordinary cargo.

Furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces and brewing stands process their contents. Cauldrons, composters, lecterns, chiseled bookshelves and decorated pots also have supported interactions.$(br2)Put materials and fuel directly into workstations, then collect results from their screens. Cargo suits these self-contained processes.
